name: team-settings
title: Team Settings
description: Workspace team management: invite members, change roles, remove members, and manage pending invitations, backed by the framework's team service.

files.content:
/** * Team settings loading skeleton. */ import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"; export default function TeamSettingsLoading() { return (
{[1, 2, 3].map((row) => (
))}
); }

{
  "page": {
    "title": "Team",
    "descriptionManage": "Manage who has access to {workspace}.",
    "descriptionReadOnly": "People with access to {workspace}."
  },
  "inviteForm": {
    "title": "Invite a team member",
    "description": "Send an invitation to join this workspace.",
    "emailLabel": "Email",
    "emailPlaceholder": "colleague@example.com",
    "roleLabel": "Role",
    "rolePlaceholder": "Select a role",
    "submit": "Send invitation",
    "submitPending": "Sending…",
    "inviteSent": "Invitation sent to {email}"
  },
  "roles": {
    "owner": "Owner",
    "admin": "Admin",
    "member": "Member"
  },
  "memberList": {
    "heading": "Members ({count})",
    "empty": "No members yet.",
    "columns": {
      "name": "Name",
      "email": "Email",
      "role": "Role",
      "joined": "Joined",
      "actions": "Actions"
    },
    "you": "(You)",
    "roleUpdated": "Role updated",
    "memberRemoved": "{name} removed from the workspace",
    "removeDialog": {
      "trigger": "Remove",
      "title": "Remove member",
      "description": "Are you sure you want to remove {name} from the workspace? They will lose access to everything in it.",
      "confirm": "Remove",
      "confirmPending": "Removing…"
    },
    "emptyHint": "Invite someone above to share this workspace."
  },
  "pendingInvitations": {
    "heading": "Pending invitations ({count})",
    "empty": "No pending invitations.",
    "columns": {
      "email": "Email",
      "role": "Role",
      "status": "Status",
      "expires": "Expires",
      "actions": "Actions"
    },
    "expired": "Expired",
    "cancel": "Cancel",
    "cancelPending": "Canceling…",
    "canceled": "Invitation canceled",
    "emptyHint": "Invitations you send appear here until they're accepted."
  },
  "errors": {
    "invitationNotFound": "That invitation no longer exists.",
    "soleOwner": "You're the only owner of this workspace. Transfer ownership before leaving.",
    "forbidden": "You don't have permission to do that.",
    "acceptVerificationFailed": "We couldn't confirm the invitation. Please try again.",
    "providerError": "Something went wrong. Please try again.",
    "somethingWentWrong": "Something went wrong.",
    "invalidInput": "Invalid input"
  }
}
